## Activity

Harbour Eye Clinic recorded 406 captures during January 2026. This activity represents the imaging completed at the site during the reporting month. The number of captures provides the basis for reviewing image quality and the subsequent grading workload.

## Image quality

There were 25 ungradable captures. The ungradable rate was 6.2 per cent. Recurring camera issues should be logged with the service desk so that they can be reviewed and addressed through the appropriate operational process. Consistent reporting of these issues will support monitoring of equipment performance and help identify any continuing effect on image quality.

## Grading

A total of 125 captures were graded as referable. The median grading lag was 2. This result should be considered alongside the activity volume and the image-quality findings when reviewing the site’s overall operational performance. Continued attention to timely grading and clear escalation of technical problems will support the service’s ongoing delivery.
